lines.text: On a noisy platform @sai_front slips on @headphones_black, and the crowd noise drops away to music.
Sound cuts to the music on the put-on.

new_beats.text: @sai_front closes his eyes and lets out a slow, relieved breath.

writes.note: I added a beat where @sai_front exhales as the noise falls away.

reply.rationale: The shot shows the put-on and the sound drop but not the reaction. A short timed moment after the cut lands the calm without changing the existing words.
